REVIEW_DECISION: REJECT
RISK_CLASS: high-impact
SUMMARY: Contract governance can be bypassed by introducing a new Factory contract at an unrecognized path and labeling the change as an ordinary refactor. The relationship validator detects only enumerated files and selected prefixes, not the full Factory-contract namespace or semantic contract additions.
FINDING: high|scripts/factory-ng-provenance-validate.py|Factory-contract classification uses a finite path allowlist that omits new documents under docs/factory-ng/|A new acceptance, routing, telemetry, or authority contract can avoid Factory classification and required independent Sol/Opus review, violating mandatory proposed-only governance
REQUIRED_CHANGE: Classify all Factory NG policy/contract paths conservatively as factory changes, with reviewed explicit exclusions for non-contract artifacts, and add a fixture proving a newly introduced contract document cannot pass as refactor
COUNTEREXAMPLE: An accepted record with change_class=refactor, contract_change_scope=none, changed_paths=["docs/factory-ng/new-acceptance-policy-v2.md"], and one ordinary Qwen review passes the current relationship validator despite changing acceptance semantics
